name: cloak
prompt: predator-style cloak: whatever moves on my camera turns into rippling, shimmering glass
notes: A motion mask (frame difference, boosted, blurred and held for a moment by a decaying loop) tells a shader where to bend the picture instead of showing it, with a cyan shimmer on the edges. Stand still and you reappear. cloak1.uniform1.x is how fully moving parts vanish, .y how hard the edges refract; hold1.brightness how long the cloak lingers.
